product_concepts.name: DropPath OS
product_concepts.tagline: The definitive command center for pro-level rotation analysis.
product_concepts.description: An interactive map overlay tool that visualizes professional team movements in real-time during tournaments. Users can toggle specific squads to study positioning and circle-timing maneuvers.
product_concepts.problem: Viewers cannot easily track team-by-team positioning during chaotic broadcast finales.
product_concepts.audienceEvidence: Consistent viewer requests for 'how-to' breakdowns of specific pro rotations.
product_concepts.competition: Static YouTube highlights; DropPath offers granular interactive manipulation.

product_concepts.name: SquadGPT
product_concepts.tagline: AI-powered tactical advice for your next match.
product_concepts.description: A conversational AI co-pilot that analyzes your match history and gives real-time tactical suggestions. It provides actionable feedback on weapon loadouts and landing efficiency.
product_concepts.problem: Players plateau because they lack objective, data-backed critiques of their playstyle.
product_concepts.audienceEvidence: High engagement with 'Pro Tips' segments on the channel.
product_concepts.competition: Generic coaching services; SquadGPT uses actual API match data for specific AI training.

product_concepts.name: The Pro Circuit Vault
product_concepts.tagline: Master the meta with exclusive pro-player masterclasses.
product_concepts.description: A gated knowledge hub featuring in-depth long-form tutorials from the world's top PUBG pros. Includes raw, uncut comms from tournament finals.
product_concepts.problem: High-level professional strategy is fragmented and rarely accessible in structured formats.
product_concepts.audienceEvidence: Massive community growth around tournament broadcast windows.
product_concepts.competition: Free YouTube videos; Vault offers professional-grade curation and community.
